title: 第一卷 第7章 赵家少主赵龙腾第一卷 第8章 挑衅秦家
lines: 听到这话，柳生大喜过望，让柳依依上前敬酒。
赵龙腾伸出手来，想要拉柳依依的手。
柳依依羞答答的向后退了一步，脸上露出一丝欲拒还迎的媚笑。
见状，赵龙腾已经是心痒难耐。
这种咫尺可得却又够不着的感觉实在是太难受了。
“少主，我家依依还是个未出阁的姑娘，还有些害羞，少主在火风城的这几天不妨多亲近亲近......”
柳生笑眯眯的看着这一幕，对女儿的表现很是满意。
“爹，你在说什么啊！”
柳依依霞飞双颊，立即捂着脸转身躲到了后面。
“哈哈，女儿家脸皮薄......”
柳生佯做抱歉的说着。
不过他心中可不是这么想的。
得不到的才是最好的。
就是要吊着他赵家少主，这样这位少主才能给他们柳家做事。
“无妨，我在这火风城还要待一段时间，正好和依依姑娘亲近亲近。”
赵龙腾说着站起身来。
“柳世伯，晚辈还要去一趟城主府，就先告辞了！”
赵龙腾起身告辞离开，站在他身后的老者一言不发的跟了上来。
柳家和火风城其他家族的人纷纷起身相送，到了门口，柳依依三叔谄媚的走了过来。
“公子，那依依的事情......”
话音未落，赵龙腾不屑看向火风城各大家族的人。
“柳家的事就是我赵龙腾的事情，我看哪个不开眼的敢上门闹事！”
柳家众人立即放心。
以这位赵少主的身份，他的一句话就足以镇住所有人。
“多谢公子，我也想看看，那秦家小儿究竟敢不敢来我们柳家！”
眼看有人撑腰，柳生也是趾高气扬的放出话来。
“杨老，查的怎么样了？”
离开柳家，赵龙腾立即询问身后老者。
“少主，已经查清楚了，这柳家女子在火风城可是名声不佳！”
“哦？说来听听！”
“少主不知，她和秦家少族长秦玄订婚，各种戏弄秦家，还和城中的几个公子哥不清不楚，柳家也是贪得无厌......”
听到这里，赵龙腾冷笑一声。
“我就说嘛，这女人虽然装的清纯，可那样子和我在玄龙城见过的那些风尘女子几乎没有区别。”
“本来都是一手交钱，一手交人，装什么白莲花！”
content_en:
Hearing this, Liu Sheng was overjoyed and asked Liu Yiyi to come forward and propose a toast.
Zhao Longteng stretched out his hand and wanted to take Liu Yiyi's hand.
Liu Yiyi took a step back shyly, with a charming smile on her face.
Seeing this, Zhao Longteng was already feeling itchy.
This feeling of being so close but just out of reach is really uncomfortable.
"Young Master, my Yiyi is still a girl who has not left the court, and is still a little shy. Young Master, you might as well get closer and closer to me during these few days in Huofeng City..."
Yagyu watched this scene with a smile, very satisfied with his daughter's performance.
"Dad, what are you talking about!"
Liu Yixia's cheeks flew away, and she immediately covered her face and turned around to hide behind.
"Haha, my daughter's family is thin-skinned..."
Yagyu said pretending to be sorry.
But that's not what he had in mind.
What you can’t get is the best.
He wanted to hang up the young master of the Zhao family, so that the young master could work for their Liu family.
"It doesn't matter, I will stay in Huofeng City for a while, just in time to get close to Miss Yiyi."
Zhao Longteng stood up as he spoke.
"Liu Shibo, I have to go to the City Lord's Mansion, so I'll take my leave now!"
Zhao Longteng stood up to say goodbye and left, and the old man standing behind him followed him without saying a word.
People from the Liu family and other families in Huofeng City stood up to see each other off. When they arrived at the door, Uncle Liu Yiyi came over flatteringly.
"Sir, what happened with Yiyi..."
Before he finished speaking, Zhao Longteng looked disdainfully at the people from the major families in Huofeng City.
"The Liu family's business is my, Zhao Longteng's, business. I don't see any blind person who dares to come and cause trouble!"
Everyone in the Liu family immediately felt relieved.
As Young Master Zhao, his words were enough to calm everyone.
"Thank you, sir. I also want to see if the Qin family's kid dares to come to our Liu family!"
Seeing someone supporting him, Yagyu spoke arrogantly.
"Mr. Yang, how's the investigation going?"
After leaving Liu's house, Zhao Longteng immediately asked the old man behind him.
"Young Master, we have found out that this Liu family woman has a bad reputation in Huofeng City!"
"Oh? Tell me!"
"Young master doesn't know that she is engaged to Qin Xuan, the young patriarch of the Qin family. She is teasing the Qin family in various ways. She is also confused with several young masters in the city. The Liu family is also greedy..."
Hearing this, Zhao Longteng sneered.
"Let me tell you, although this woman pretends to be innocent, she looks almost the same as the promiscuous women I saw in Xuanlong City."
"Originally, I paid with one hand and handed people with the other. Why are you pretending to be a white lotus!"
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 7 The Young Master of the Zhao Family, Zhao Longteng Volume 1 Chapter 8 Provoking the Qin Family
